My Story Detective.

An adaptive reading companion designed to help young readers build comprehension, vocabulary, and confidence through guided conversations about books.

Follow platform development →All platforms

About the platform

Reading support that listens and responds.

My Story Detective engages children in conversations while they read illustrated storybooks. It asks questions, encourages discussion, and adapts support based on each child’s responses.

The platform is being developed through the CHAT-ABLE project, combining literacy science, educational technology, and AI to expand access to individualized reading support.

Platform access: My Story Detective is currently in development. A public platform link has not yet been released.

LearnersChildren in kindergarten through grade 2
FocusComprehension, vocabulary, and critical thinking
ExperienceAdaptive dialogue around illustrated stories

Learning design

Turn reading into an active exchange.

Guided Conversation

Prompts invite children to explain events, characters, and ideas in their own words.

Adaptive Support

The experience responds to learners and provides help aligned with their developing skills.

Home and School

The project explores ways to support reading with educators and families across learning settings.

In development

Follow the work as the platform grows.

The five-year research project is developing a collection of more than 65 illustrated storybooks and studying how AI-supported dialogue can help young readers.
